text: For smallholders, the two priority vaccines are CSF (the single most important vaccine, needing a regular vaccination program) and FMD (a trivalent O+A+Asia1 vaccine is strongly recommended for sows, boars, and gilts). For semi-commercial farms, supplementary vaccines include Parvovirus (for sows and gilts, 2 weeks before mating, to prevent reproductive failure — often combined with an Erysipelas vaccine — plus boars) and Aujeszky (especially for sows, gilts, and boars; sows vaccinated during gestation, boars twice a year). Vaccines against Atrophic Rhinitis, Mycoplasma, E. coli, PRRS, and Circovirus are generally not necessary and should only be used after proper diagnosis and risk assessment; vaccines against Pasteurella and Salmonella are not recommended.
